translation: Do not sweat again. Reaching the fourth day it is in the chest; one should take the Lilu Pill (Veratrum Pill) and slight vomiting cures it. If it is more severe, and the Lilu Pill cannot make one vomit, take the Xiaodou Guadi Powder (Small Bean and Melon Stalk Powder) to vomit, and it heals. See whether the disease has not yet awakened; if it awakens, needle it with another method. (The Lilu Pill, being recently used, harms people, so it is not recorded; the Guadi Powder is the one of two ingredients in Fan Wang's formula in the miscellaneous treatments at the end of the volume.) On the fifth day it is in the abdomen, and on the sixth day it enters the stomach; once it enters the stomach, one can purge it.
